answer: Each identity anchors a lagoon gauge and locks a 70-credit bond. Each epoch it posts a gauge reading matching the board lagoon level within 2 cm, sealed with its opal seal and linked to its public thread. Auditors re-check 10 percent of gauges; a mismatch or missing reading burns the bond. A fake needs its own gauge: 45 credits per epoch plus the 70 bond, so the kth fake costs 115 and 1,000 fakes cost 115,000. One gauge serves one identity: a rented-gauge ring shares seal fingerprints, and thread audit burns both bonds. An honest identity pays one fee and one bond and keeps its full share.
